source: AwsSolutions-IAM5 findings from the synthesized AnyWearFoundationStack and AnyWearPlatformStack-beta, plus the count of wildcard-bearing policy statements in each stack's template. Regenerate with the same inputs test/authorization-lint.test.ts synthesizes. A wildcard-bearing statement is one whose Action or Resource carries a `*` in any AWS::IAM::Policy, AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy or role-inline policy document, and `id` is the cdk-nag rule argument verbatim with `arn:<AWS::Partition>` normalized to `arn:aws`. Every entry carries a reviewed reason.

findings.reason: The dev, beta and production GitHub Actions pipeline roles assume the ap-east-1 CDK bootstrap deploy/file-publishing/lookup roles; the `*` is the CDK role-family segment in `cdk-<kind>-role`, and the account and region are fixed. No Infra deploy or runtime statement carries this form.
The dev pipeline role reads the dev stage-contract prefix; every parameter under `/anywear/dev/` is published by the reviewed dev deploy. Read only, no write or version action.
The dev pipeline role reads the dev CloudFront origin-header secret; the wildcard is the Secrets Manager random suffix after the fixed name prefix. Read only.
The dev pipeline role reads the dev ARK/QWeather API-key secret; the wildcard is the Secrets Manager random suffix after the fixed name prefix. Read only.
The beta pipeline role also assumes the us-east-1 CDK bootstrap roles for the Billing stack; the `*` is the CDK role-family segment, and the account and region are fixed.
The beta pipeline role reads the beta stage-contract prefix; `/anywear/beta/` is published by the reviewed Base deploy. Read only.
The beta pipeline role reads the Beta CloudFront origin-header secret; the wildcard is the Secrets Manager random suffix after the fixed name prefix. Read only.
The production pipeline role reads the production stage-contract prefix; every parameter under `/anywear/prod/` is published by the reviewed production deploy. Read only.
The production pipeline role reads the production CloudFront origin-header secret; the wildcard is the Secrets Manager random suffix after the fixed name prefix. Read only.
The runtime role's Foundation statement reads the Runtime stack's terminal state for the one-writer rule; the wildcard is the stack UUID CloudFormation appends, not part of the stack name.

The runtime role keeps the transitional read of the legacy Workload stack until the one-time split migration deletes it; the wildcard is the stack UUID. The read is used only for the pre-MOVE API origin.

Two statements: the CDK-generated OpenID Connect provider custom-resource role's iam:Create/Delete/UpdateOpenIDConnectProvider* actions, which have no resource-level scope, and the beta artifact role's ecr:GetAuthorizationToken. cdk-nag reports one id per stack for every bare `*` form, so the per-stack count is what catches an added `*` statement.

The beta pipeline role's S3 statement on the two retained buckets uses the AWS `GetObject*` action family; the resource side is the bucket ARN plus `/*` only, so the wildcard is in the action name, not in an object path.
The same pipeline statement's `GetBucket*` family (location/versioning/policy reads) on the retained bucket ARNs; no bucket outside the two Base-owned buckets is named.
The same pipeline statement's `List*` family on the two retained bucket ARNs; the bucket list surface is the reviewed deployment input, and no other bucket is named.
The same pipeline statement's `DeleteObject*` family (object and object-version deletion) on the two retained bucket ARNs; it is the release/cleanup surface and adds no bucket.
The same pipeline statement's `Abort*` family, needed to abort an incomplete multipart upload on either retained bucket. No resource outside the two buckets.
The CDK GetAtt rendering of the retained wardrobe bucket ARN plus `/*`; the bucket is Base-owned and retained, and `/*` is the object-key position only.
The CDK GetAtt rendering of the retained client-publish bucket ARN plus `/*`; the bucket is Base-owned and retained, and `/*` is the object-key position only.

Twenty-seven statements: account-level reads that have no resource type (ECS DescribeTaskDefinition/ListTasks, EC2 DescribeManagedPrefixLists, CloudWatch GetMetricStatistics, RDS Describe*, CloudWatch Logs DescribeLogGroups, application-autoscaling Describe*), the E2E qualification role's read-only `cloudtrail:LookupEvents` (#217, which has no resource-level scope), ecr:GetAuthorizationToken in the pipeline and one-shot-execution roles, the IAM simulator pair on the deploy and runtime roles, and the CDK LogRetention provider's logs:PutRetentionPolicy/DeleteRetentionPolicy. cdk-nag collapses every bare `*` into one id, so the per-stack count guards an added `*` statement.

Issue #217: the Beta tester-cleanup task role deletes a captured user's `wearable-items/<sub>/` objects before their rows are removed. The wildcard is the per-user object key under that fixed prefix; the bucket ARN is the CDK GetAtt of the retained Base-owned wardrobe bucket, and the role's only other S3 statement is the matching `base-photos/` delete plus the two-prefix ListBucket. No other bucket or prefix is granted.

Issue #217: the same Beta tester-cleanup task role deletes a captured user's `base-photos/<sub>/` objects. The wildcard is the per-user object key under that fixed prefix and the bucket ARN is the same retained Base-owned wardrobe bucket GetAtt, so the delete scope is exactly the two per-user prefixes the cleanup operation reads from `S3_BUCKET_NAME`.
The pipeline role sets the retention of the pre-sign-up Lambda log group; the wildcard is the log-stream suffix CloudFormation Logs appends, and the log group name is fixed.
The pipeline role sets the retention of the post-confirmation-sync Lambda log group; the wildcard is the log-stream suffix, and the log group name is fixed.

The CDK-generated helper functions of the Base stack get their log-group retention through the same pipeline statement; the first `*` is the generated helper-function suffix, the second is the log-stream suffix.
The pipeline role reads the Base stack's generated helper functions; the `*` is the CDK-generated logical/physical suffix in the function name, and no other function matches.
The beta pipeline role registers, tags, lists and runs revisions of the reviewed `migrate` one-shot family; `:*` is the task-definition revision number only.
The beta pipeline role registers, tags, lists and runs revisions of the reviewed `verify` one-shot family (including the schema-journal probe); `:*` is the revision number only.
The beta pipeline role registers, tags, lists and runs revisions of the reviewed `lifecycle` one-shot family; `:*` is the revision number only.
The beta pipeline role registers, tags, lists and runs revisions of the reviewed `tester-cleanup` one-shot family; `:*` is the revision number only.
The beta pipeline role registers, tags and lists revisions of the reviewed `task-audit` one-shot family; `:*` is the revision number only.

The reviewed `nonpaid-*` task families (the admission fixture families) share one prefix; the first `*` is the family suffix and the second is the revision number. The prefix is the reviewed admission-test surface.
The reviewed lifecycle fixture family registered by the admission tests; `:*` is the revision number only.
The migration evidence family; the first `*` is the generated evidence suffix, the second is the revision number, and the `beta-anywear-migrate-evidence-` prefix is fixed.
The verification evidence family; the first `*` is the generated evidence suffix, the second is the revision number, and the `beta-anywear-verify-evidence-` prefix is fixed.
The lifecycle evidence family; the first `*` is the generated evidence suffix, the second is the revision number, and the `beta-anywear-lifecycle-evidence-` prefix is fixed.
The lifecycle-fixture evidence family; the first `*` is the generated evidence suffix, the second is the revision number, and the `beta-anywear-lifecycle-fixture-evidence-` prefix is fixed.
The pipeline role stops and reads tasks in the dedicated `beta-anywear` cluster; the `*` is the task id, and the cluster and family path are fixed.
The pipeline role filters log events for the API service's reviewed log group; the wildcard is the log-stream suffix, and the log group name is fixed.
The pipeline role filters log events for the worker's reviewed log group; the wildcard is the log-stream suffix, and the log group name is fixed.
The CDK LogRetention provider deletes the container-insights performance log group; the wildcard is the log-stream suffix and the log group name is fixed.
The task-evidence managed policy lists tags on worker task definitions; `:*` is the revision number only.
The task-evidence managed policy lists tags on API task definitions; `:*` is the revision number only.
The task-evidence managed policy reads the reviewed `migrate` one-shot log stream; the wildcard is the OneShot stream id, and the log group and family prefix are fixed.
The task-evidence managed policy reads the reviewed `verify` one-shot log stream; the wildcard is the OneShot stream id, and the log group and family prefix are fixed.
The task-evidence managed policy reads the reviewed `lifecycle` one-shot log stream; the wildcard is the OneShot stream id, and the log group and family prefix are fixed.
The task-evidence managed policy reads the reviewed `tester-cleanup` one-shot log stream; the wildcard is the OneShot stream id, and the log group and family prefix are fixed.
The task-evidence managed policy reads the reviewed `task-audit` one-shot log stream; the wildcard is the OneShot stream id, and the log group and family prefix are fixed.
The task-evidence managed policy reads the reviewed lifecycle-fixture one-shot log stream; the wildcard is the OneShot stream id, and the log group and family prefix are fixed.
The task-evidence managed policy reads migration evidence streams; the first `*` is the generated evidence suffix, the second is the OneShot stream id, and the log group and family prefix are fixed.

The task-evidence managed policy reads verification evidence streams; the first `*` is the generated evidence suffix, the second is the OneShot stream id, and the log group and family prefix are fixed.
The task-evidence managed policy reads lifecycle evidence streams; the first `*` is the generated evidence suffix, the second is the OneShot stream id, and the log group and family prefix are fixed.

The task-evidence managed policy reads lifecycle-fixture evidence streams; the first `*` is the generated evidence suffix, the second is the OneShot stream id, and the log group and family prefix are fixed.
The Infra deploy and runtime roles read the Foundation stack; the wildcard is the stack UUID CloudFormation appends, not part of the stack name.
The Infra deploy and runtime roles read the Base stack; the wildcard is the stack UUID CloudFormation appends, not part of the stack name.

The Infra deploy role reads the Runtime stack and describes, executes or deletes this run's change set on it; the wildcard is the stack UUID, and the change-set actions stay scoped to the Runtime stack.
The Infra deploy and runtime roles read the Billing stack in us-east-1; the wildcard is the stack UUID, and the region is fixed.

The `deploy-runtime` deploy session describes, executes or deletes the change set the CDK bootstrap role created; the wildcard is the change-set name, whose reviewed form is `anywear-runtime-<run id>`. No create action is granted.
The deploy session reads the Beta CloudFront origin-header secret that seeds the distribution; the wildcard is the Secrets Manager random suffix after the fixed name prefix. Read only.

The runtime role reads the full stage-contract prefix: the 39 published contract names plus the admission and record parameter names; every value under `/anywear/beta/` is published by the reviewed Base deploy. Read only.
The runtime role reads the disposable Egress stack to enforce the stop ordering (Runtime absent before the Egress delete) and the one-writer rule; the wildcard is the stack UUID.
The 300-second bake records the deployed bake and queue alarm states under the reviewed `beta-anywear-*` alarm prefix; the alarm names are the only wildcard position and no alarm is written.
The runtime role registers, tags and runs revisions of the reviewed `artifact-verify` one-shot family; `:*` is the revision number only.
The runtime role reads the reviewed `artifact-verify` one-shot log stream; the wildcard is the OneShot stream id, and the log group and family prefix are fixed.
The E2E qualification role reads the Beta stage's registered scalable targets; the `*` is the scalable-target id, and the account and region are fixed. Read only.
